rule.share80: A higher share of people aged 80+ than the median Małopolska municipality ({share}% against {median}%) → solutions for older people.
rule.depopulation: The population fell by {change}% between {from} and {to} → solutions for older people, against digital exclusion and for getting around.
rule.rural: A rural municipality — people often have to travel to reach services → solutions that help with getting around.
rule.urbanRural: An urban-rural municipality (with rural areas) — people often have to travel to reach services → solutions that help with getting around.
rule.reported: In {where}, {count, plural, one {# need was} other {# needs were}} reported in the last {days} days in the area “{area}” → solutions from this area.
rule.none: The GUS data show no particular needs here (the share of people aged 80+ is not above the median, the population is not falling, it is an urban municipality) → we show solutions ROPS selected for wider use.
